limitations: Rigid 3DOF plate and linear unilateral normal springs; not nonlinear contact FEM.
Preload is an ideal constant internal compression force per surviving support, not torque or real clamp force.
Friction: T_i=F_t*k_i/sum(k_active) is assumed, not computed from tangent stiffness or stick-slip.
Full-rank active-set search ignores possible lower-rank neutral equilibrium; unresolved != physical failure.
No real basket 3D geometry, screw design, joint relaxation, bolt tension, insert pull-out, MDF strength, or material friction measurements.
